text:
adele: Quick proposal — add a privacy-aware "guest roaming" routing mode for Dedicated tenants that allows controlled spillover to Hosted when their pool is saturated. details below.

mike: high level: deny by default. customers opt-in per-tenant + region. otherwise we should always fail fast.

sasha: what does "privacy-aware" mean here? redaction? pseudonymization?

adele: two parts: 1) metadata-only spillover (no full prompt payload), 2) sampled full payloads with automatic PII redaction and customer consent opt-in. we mark events as `spillover=hosted_priv_meta` vs `spillover=hosted_priv_full_sampled`.

jordan: telemetry-wise we need fields: `route_decision`, `fallback_reason`, `variant_id`, `tenant_id_hash`, `region`, `latency_ms`, `kv_cache_hit`. keep tenant_id hashed so billing can still attribute.

sasha: agree on hashed tenant id. also add `policy_version` so Console can show which policy made the decision.

ops-bot: deploy-check: policy api change requires schema bump v2.0 (breaking) — see CI job #823.

mike: API debate: should routing decision live in control plane or inside runtime? control plane = easier policy changes, runtime = lower latency. leaning control plane but add cache to avoid chattiness.

adele: my thinking: control plane evaluates policy, returns `route_hint` + TTL. runtime honors hint, can override if local capacity changed. need a quick handshake for handoff in <50ms.

maya: UX question: Console toggle UI — per-tenant "Allow hosted spillover (privacy-aware)" with hover tooltip + link to audit log. Also show recent spillover count and estimated cost impact.

zainab: telemetry to support UI: expose `spillover_count_24h`, `spillover_rate`, and `median_latency_delta` in tenant dashboard. add an alert when spillover_rate > 5%.

sasha: rollout plan: default off. ship policy + telemetry + console toggle. enable for 3 pilot tenants under NDA. feature flag to enable sampling/PII redaction.

mike: about model variant fallback: order should be: 1) same model, same quant, same region/dedicated 2) same model + hosted variant (quant difference) 3) lower-capacity model in region 4) cross-region hosted. only cross-region if tenant allows.

adele: add a `fallback_score` in telemetry so we can tune ordering. score = latency_penalty + quality_penalty + privacy_penalty.

jordan: one more: billing/quotas. if tenant spills to hosted, we need to track tokens billed to tenant and whether cost came from their reserved pool or hosted. add `billed_to` enum: `tenant_reserved` | `tenant_hosted_charge` | `platform_cover`.

maya: Console copy: show clear warning: "Spillover may send request metadata or sampled content to Redwood Hosted. Enabled only with consent. Audits available." include link to privacy docs.

sasha: security ask: if sampled full payloads are stored for regression/eval, they must be encrypted and TTL=30d. also make sampling opt-out.

adele: prototype policy JSON (very small):
```
{"policy_name":"guest_roam_v1","allow_spillover":true,"spillover_modes":["meta_only","sample_full"],"regions_allowed":["us-west-2"],"sampling_rate":0.01}
```

mike: we need an internal API change: `POST /route/decision` -> returns `{route: "dedicated|hosted", hint_ttl, meta_only, variant_id}`. runtime will call once per request if no cached hint.

jordan: telemetry event schema: `route_event` with tags above + `eviction_id` if tenant was evicted. store event in logs and metric counter.

zainab: observability: add Grafana panel for spillover_by_tenant and a per-tenant table in Console with links to traces. sample trace span: `route_eval -> handshake -> runtime_forward`.

maya: UX for rollouts: canary toggle that enables spillover for N tenants or X% of traffic. console should let us pick pilot tenants easily.

sasha: I volunteer to own telemetry schema PR and dashboards. will draft today.

adele: I'll draft API + policy schema. mike, can you prototype the runtime handshake TTL cache?

mike: yes, will start a spike tomorrow. I'll post notes in the thread.

ops-bot: CI status: spike branch created at `feature/guest-roam-spike` — pipeline queued :hourglass:.

jordan: action items: adele -> policy draft, sasha -> telemetry PR, mike -> runtime spike, maya -> Console copy + mockups. target: pilot in 3 weeks.

mike: one last note: make sure customer support docs explain the opt-in and how to revoke consent. customer success should be looped in.

adele: good call. paging @martha-cs to review copy when ready. :thumbsup:

martha-cs: thanks — saw the ping, will review when mockups are up.
